rationale: The four views agree on a single compact bar-like mass, so gesture clarity and repair integrity are moderate-to-good. However, the form is still mostly a blunt extrusion with only minor bending and a very small carved recess, so hierarchy is weak and the public-void reading is limited. The blue access edge is acknowledged only indirectly: the mass does not open a convincing ground threshold toward the frontage, which is a program-critical weakness for neighborhood living. In section, the roofline and internal void do not yet communicate an active mixed-use ground, terrace, or inhabitable public cut; the object feels more like a generic block with a clipped top than a neighborhood building. The form also lacks the stronger section/program logic seen in the better references, especially the courtyard-and-terrace principle of the counterfactual. Overall it is coherent as a mass, but not yet program-fit enough to pass.
